data.charger_startable_states: States in which charging can be started

data_description.entity_prices: Select the Home Assistant sensor that provides the electricity price forecast.
data_description.entity_solcast_today: Select the Solcast sensor containing today's hourly PV forecast.
data_description.entity_solcast_tomorrow: Select the Solcast sensor containing tomorrow's hourly PV forecast.
data_description.charger_mode_entity: Setting both the mode sensor and the current number enables the charge control. Leave empty to only use the planner.
data_description.charger_connected_states: Comma separated list of mode values. Default: connected_requesting,connected_charging,connected_finished
data_description.charger_charging_states: Comma separated list of mode values. Default: connected_charging
data_description.charger_startable_states: Comma separated list of mode values. Default: connected_requesting,connected_finished
data_description.charger_current_entity: Number entity that sets the maximum charging current in ampere.
data_description.charger_start_entity: Switch that starts charging. Without one, the charger is assumed to start by itself once a current is set.
data_description.charger_stop_entity: Button (pressed) or switch (turned off) that stops charging. Defaults to turning off the start switch.
data_description.charger_phase_entity: Number entity that switches between 1 and 3 phases. Leave empty if the charger cannot switch phases.
data_description.charger_phase_one_value: Value of the phase number that means 1 phase (default 32).
data_description.charger_phase_three_value: Value of the phase number that means 3 phases (default 0).
data_description.charger_energy_entity: Total or session energy sensor of the charger. Enables the planned versus actual energy feedback.
data_description.entity_price_forecast: Sensor with a 'raw_forecast' attribute (start, end, value in EUR/kWh). Only used for hours whose final price is not known yet. Leave empty to disable.
